Reagents
Real-time PCR

Extracted RNA was converted to cDNA using a High Capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription kit. Real-time PCR was performed on a CFX96 system (Bio-Rad) using Taqman PCR Universal MasterMix and specific Taqman assays. Experiments were performed in triplicate.
TBP, RNU44 and U6 were used as reference genes.  (002419); miR-15a-5p (000389); miR-16-1-3p (002420); miR-16-5p (000391); TBP (human Hs00427620, mouse Mm_00446971); RNU44 (001094);

VEGFR2 5'-CCAACGAAGAGCCCTAGTGA-3' and 5'-ACCAGAAGGAACGAATGTGG-3';
DLEU2 5'-TTTGTGCAGTTTCAGCAAAG-3' and 5'-CTGTGTACTTAGGTCGTGTG-3'; and SMC4 5' CTGAAGAGGCGTTTCTGGAC-3' and 5'-GGAAGAGCGAGGGATTCTTT-3';
